Made this mod as a meme or joke, see Weather Alert Discussion board if interested

This lightweight SMAPI mod greets you the first time you load into your farm each session with a simple message:

[quote][b]“Welcome, <FarmerName>. You are playing Stardew Valley right now. Happy Stardew!”
[/b][/quote]It triggers [b]once per session[/b], then stays quiet until you quit and reopen the game or load a different save.

Happy Stardew!



Code at: https://github.com/ZeroXPatch/Projects-for-Nexus-Mod/tree/main/NowPlayingStardewReminder
